pytorch.reason: Core: metric scaling g̃=e^{2f}g computation, Ricci and Weyl tensor extraction from Riemann curvature, conformal invariance verification via eigenvalues

pyg.reason: not needed — Weyl tensor is differential-geometric

z3.reason: Proof: claim that dim=4 AND Weyl tensor vanishes for non-conformally-flat is UNSAT (only true for dim≤3)

sympy.reason: Symbolic: Weyl tensor formula W = R - 1/(n-2)(Ric ⊗ g) (dim-dependent), Cotton tensor algebraic identity, verify W invariance under conformal rescaling

geomstats.reason: Cross-check: metric geodesic properties are invariant under conformal scaling, Riemannian structure validation

P1_conformal_equivalence.comment: Metrics g and e^{2f}g belong to same conformal class [g]

P2_weyl_conformal_invariant.comment: Weyl tensor W is conformal invariant (unchanged under g→e^{2f}g) in dim≥4

P3_weyl_vanishes_dim3.comment: Weyl tensor identically vanishes in dim=3 (always conformally flat)

P4_dimension_gate.comment: Conformal structure gates on dimension: dim=2 infinite-dimensional, dim≥3 finite

P5_cotton_tensor_dim3.comment: Cotton tensor C_ij vanishes iff metric is conformally flat in dim=3

N1_dim4_conformal_not_universal.comment: In dim=4: conformal equivalence is a strict constraint (not all metrics equivalent)

N2_weyl_nonzero_not_conformally_flat.comment: W≠0 implies metric is NOT conformally flat (and vice versa)

N3_different_signature_not_conformal.comment: Metrics with different signature cannot be conformally equivalent

N4_dim2_weyl_must_vanish.comment: In dim=2, Weyl tensor is always identically zero

B1_dimension_2_always_flat.comment: Every 2D Riemannian metric is conformally equivalent to Euclidean

B2_dimension_3_cotton_constraint.comment: In dim=3, conformal flatness iff Cotton tensor vanishes

B3_dimension_4plus_weyl_constraint.comment: In dim≥4, conformal flatness iff Weyl tensor vanishes

B4_conformal_rescaling_limit.comment: Eigenvalues scale correctly under conformal rescaling g→e^{2f}g
